review_method: Visual inspection of sampled source frames, cropped action contact sheets, and start/middle/end full frames; linear geometry interpolation between manually placed keyframes. Samples are approximately 1 second apart, sometimes 2 seconds. This is not a claim that every source frame was visually reviewed.
completion_scope: Fixed objects plus visually clear small/rare objects; dynamic people/hands handled separately. Temporal changes between samples retain explicit uncertainty.
